else:
    # Select only the numeric columns from the DataFrame
    numeric_cols = df.select_dtypes(include=[np.number])

    # Calculate the mean, median, and standard deviation for all numeric columns
    mean = numeric_cols.mean()
    median = numeric_cols.median()
    std_dev = numeric_cols.std()

    # Print the results
    print("Mean:\n", mean)
    print("\nMedian:\n", median)
    print("\nStandard Deviation:\n", std_dev)

    # Plotting the data can provide a visual representation of the distribution of data
    # Import necessary libraries for plotting
    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
    import seaborn as sns

    # Create a boxplot for each numeric column to visualize the mean, median and standard deviation
    for col in numeric_cols.columns:
        plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
        sns.boxplot(x=numeric_cols[col])
        plt.title(f'Boxplot of {col}')
        plt.show()
